prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. GEAR AND PROPS sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same design, items, their order and names. Ranged and arcane weapons sheet 2, each group with a small heading label, each item shown in four material tiers side by side labelled "Copper", "Iron", "Skysteel", "Relic". Top row: "Short bow", "Longbow", "Javelins", "Throwing axes" (two of each tier), "Bolas". Middle row: "Quivers". Bottom row headed "Arcane foci" for the five arcane skills: "Wind" (feathered fan or staff), "Stone" (rune-carved maul-staff), "Tide" (shell-and-crystal chalice), "Bloom" (living-wood staff with leaves and flowers), "Oathcraft" (chain-bound tome and seal). Thick bow limbs and solid thick bowstrings, chunky shafts, bolas cords as thick solid rope, everything at true scale to the 1.8 m figure at the top left. Only labels, no description text. Even flat light, no rim light. Each item alone in three-quarter front view, in rows by family or tier, with thick chunky proportions: thick blades, solid rope, chunky grips, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Shared gear: weapons, sheet 2 – ranged and arcane".
